currentRoundInspection.method: Two aerial/front photographs inspected in browser; standard viewer PMTiles/DEM control footprint, scale and facing. No bespoke survey research or redistributed photo.

pictures.observations: South/east aerial: broad eastern gold main dome and taller western open gold-capped bell tower, green copper subsidiary half-domes/roof ranges, pale coursed stone, scalloped round-arch drum windows, stacked apses, long green nave vault, west entrance steps and small gold corner caps.

Frontal west view: three lower arched portals/steps, paired porch columns, repeated side windows, central upper triple windows, green stepped roofs, two gold corner caps, taller western tower with open belfry/gold dome/cross, stone eaves/cornices and a small icon panel. Exact icons, inscriptions, sculpture and reliefs are not reconstructed.
